title: A computational study of potent series of selective estrogen receptor degraders for breast cancer therapy.
authors: Zekri, Afaf; Harkati, Dalal; Kenouche, Samir; Saleh, Basil A; Alnajjar, Radwan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过QSAR、分子对接和MD模拟分析SERD化合物与雌激素受体α的结合，属于药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: A detailed multistep framework combining quantitative structure-activity relationship, global reactivity, absorption, distribution, metabolism and elimination properties, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation (MD) on a series of Selective Estrogen Receptor Down-Regulators (SERDs) interacting with Estrogen Receptor alpha (ERalpha) has been performed. The partial least squares regression method derived an empirical model with better predictive capability. The results of global reactivity descriptors revealed that all the compounds are considered strong electrophiles, allowing them to participate in polar reactions more easily. The Brain Or IntestinaL EstimateD permeation diagram revealed that compounds 49 and 31 were predicted to be well absorbed by the human gastrointestinal tract and would not enter the brain. The elucidation of the binding mode between the most active compounds that comply with Lipinski's and Veber's rules from the dataset and ERalpha targets was explored by molecular docking. The MD simulations were performed for 100 ns on the best compounds, which indicated their stability state under dynamics simulations. These findings are expected to help predict the anticancer activities of the studied SERD compounds and better understand their binding mechanism with ERalpha targets.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 本研究针对一系列与雌激素受体α（ERalpha）相互作用的选择性雌激素受体下调剂（SERDs），开展了一个详细的多步骤框架分析，该框架结合了定量结构-活性关系、全局反应性、吸收、分布、代谢和排泄性质、分子对接及分子动力学模拟（MD）。偏最小二乘回归方法推导出一个具有更好预测能力的经验模型。全局反应性描述符的结果显示，所有化合物均被视为强亲电试剂，使其更容易参与极性反应。脑或肠道估计渗透图显示，化合物49和31被预测为能被人体胃肠道良好吸收，且不会进入大脑。通过分子对接，探讨了数据集中符合Lipinski和Veber规则的最活跃化合物与ERalpha靶标之间的结合模式。对最佳化合物进行了100 ns的MD模拟，表明它们在动力学模拟下的稳定状态。这些发现有望帮助预测所研究SERD化合物的抗癌活性，并更好地理解它们与ERalpha靶标的结合机制。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
